title: Groom Club Monthly: Cancelling Close to the Next Billing Date
content:
On Groom Club Monthly at the Tailwise Grooming Salon, a cancellation made close to the club's next billing date carries a billing-notice multiplier on the early termination fee.

**Rule.** The billing-notice multiplier on the early termination fee follows the calendar days from the cancellation date to the club's next billing date: fewer than 3 days takes 1.2, 3 to fewer than 7 days takes 1.1, and 7 days or more takes a multiplier of one.

The multiplier multiplies the early termination fee only; club late-cancellation charges are not multiplied by it.

| Calendar days from the cancellation date to the next billing date | Billing-notice multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | 1.2 |
| 3, 4, 5 or 6 | 1.1 |
| 7 or more | 1 |

The next billing date is the one on the club record when the cancellation is made.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical club, next billing date 15 June, early termination fee of 12.50 before the multiplier)**

| Cancellation date | Days to 15 June | Multiplier | Fee after the multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 13 June | 2 | 1.2 | 15.00 |
| 12 June | 3 | 1.1 | 13.75 |
| 9 June | 6 | 1.1 | 13.75 |
| 8 June | 7 | 1 | 12.50 |
